subject: HN - Full Stack
body:
Hi Tyler,

Applying for the Full-Stack Engineer role from your Hacker News post.

I'm a full-stack developer in Austria with 4+ years, currently lead developer on
Ludwig - practice-management software for physiotherapy and doctors' practices in
Germany and Austria. React, Next.js and TypeScript on the front, Node.js and
Postgres behind it, which is most of the stack you listed.

The browser-automation line is where I'd be most immediately useful. I have built
Python extraction pipelines that ingest and normalise millions of property listings
from third-party real-estate sources, and I use Playwright for end-to-end suites on
the product I work on now.

Work sample and my own contribution: the clearest piece is Ludwig's patient booking
wizard, which I built end to end in Next.js 16 and React 19. The backend describes
each practice's booking flow and the frontend normalises that into rendered steps,
so a practice can change what it asks patients without a release. It sits behind a
client login rather than being public, so I have attached my CV and I am happy to
walk through the code on a call. Public repositories: github.com/saifaslam246

I am on CET and flexible into US hours. Available immediately.

Best,
Saif ur Rehman
